weekLabel.zh: 近期更新 · 10 月 17 日 – 10 月 28 日

title.zh: GTA6 最后 22 天日历：从 11 月 5 日财报到 11 月 19 日解锁，一个不漏
title.en: GTA 6 Final Countdown Calendar: Every Date Left Before the November 19 Unlock

summary.zh: 发售前日程已排满：11/5 索尼财报、11/9 Take-Two 财报、11/12 预载开放、11/18 热火「罪恶都市之夜」与传闻中的评测解禁、11/19 午夜解锁、11/20 预购特典截止。
summary.en: The run-in is fully booked: Sony's results Nov 5, Take-Two's Nov 9, preload Nov 12, the Heat's Vice City night plus the rumoured review embargo Nov 18, the midnight unlock Nov 19, and the pre-order bonus deadline Nov 20.

title.zh: 消息称 R 星已向媒体发放 GTA6 评测码，11 月 18 日解禁——玩家只剩一天看评分
title.en: GTA 6 Review Codes Are Reportedly Out With a November 18 Embargo

summary.zh: NateTheHate 称 Rockstar 已开始发放评测码、解禁定在 11 月 18 日发售前一天，Insider Gaming 表示独立验证。Rockstar 与 Take-Two 均未确认，也没有媒体公开承认持码。
summary.en: NateTheHate says review code is out with a Nov 18 embargo, one day before launch, and Insider Gaming says it verified the date. Neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has confirmed it and no outlet has admitted holding a copy.

title.zh: GTA6 容量曝光：PS5 版据报约 210GB，11 月 12 日开放预载
title.en: GTA 6 Download Size Reported at ~210GB on PS5, Preload Opens November 12

summary.zh: PS 商店后台读数报出 PS5 版 210GB，Kotaku 等跟进转述；Xbox 商店仍是占位值，Rockstar 与索尼均未官宣。210GB 在 100Mbps 下约需 4.7 小时，Series S 用户压力最大。
summary.en: A PS Store backend reading puts the PS5 install at 210GB, picked up by Kotaku; the Xbox store still shows a placeholder and Rockstar has announced nothing. 210GB is ~4.7 hours at 100Mbps, with Series S owners squeezed hardest.

title.zh: Rockstar 首次详细说明 GTA6 任务多路线：公寓逃脱不止一条路，不照提示也能逃出去
title.en: Rockstar Details GTA 6 Mission Routes: More Than One Way Out of the Tower

summary.zh: 官方确认部分剧情任务支持多种完成方式。Rob Nelson 称离开公寓塔楼有多条路线，Raul 那段任务在固定开头后交还玩家驾驶，系统提示最佳路线但不照做也能逃脱。
summary.en: Rockstar confirms some story missions support multiple routes. Rob Nelson says there are several ways out of the tower, and the Raul sequence hands driving back to the player with a suggested route that can be ignored.

title.zh: 武器轮回归：Rockstar 花了数月甚至数年想换掉它，最后还是回到了原点
title.en: The Weapon Wheel Is Back After Rockstar Spent Years Trying to Replace It

summary.zh: Bloomberg 记者 Schreier 透露，团队想要《荒野大镖客 2》式的限重携带，试过托盘、网状 UI 乃至取消选择界面，最终还是用回武器轮；携带限制仍是「报道提及但未详述」。
summary.en: Bloomberg's Schreier says the team wanted an RDR2-style loadout limit, tried trays, web menus and no selection screen, then returned to the wheel. The carrying limit remains reported but undetailed.

title.zh: GTA6 全球分级已集齐：韩国 19+、日本 CERO Z、欧美 M/18——以及一个常见误读
title.en: GTA 6's Ratings Are In Worldwide — and One Common Misread

summary.zh: 韩国 GCRB 于 10/16 给出 19+，日本 CERO 随后给出 Z，加上 ESRB M、PEGI 18、USK 18、澳洲 R18+ 全部集齐。需要厘清：北美是 M（17+），不是 ESRB 的 AO 级。
summary.en: Korea's GCRB ruled 19+ on Oct 16 and CERO followed with Z, completing the set with ESRB M, PEGI 18, USK 18 and Australia's R18+. Clarification: North America is M (17+), not ESRB Adults Only.

title.zh: GTA6 上市预告上电视、快餐摊开进球馆：迈阿密正在被改造成罪恶都市
title.en: GTA 6 Hits TV and Its Fast-Food Stands Open in an Arena

summary.zh: 预告片出现两个电视版本；Burger Shot 与 Cluckin' Bell 实体餐摊进驻 Kaseya Center；Vice Beach 合作涉 30 万美元给城市、400 万美元给特许经营商，11/1 前未获批可能取消。
summary.en: Two TV cuts of the trailer aired; Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell stands are serving inside Kaseya Center; the Vice Beach deal involves $300K to the city and $4M to the concessionaire, cancellable if permits miss Nov 1.

title.zh: GTA6 营销占领美国街头：好莱坞壁画、布鲁克林墙绘、芝加哥巴士与时代广场大屏
title.en: GTA 6 Marketing Takes the Streets: Hollywood, Brooklyn, Chicago, Times Square

summary.zh: 户外广告同时在好莱坞大道、布鲁克林、芝加哥与时代广场铺开，含 Colossal Media 手绘墙绘与 Spotify 原声广告牌。同期 Xbox 一张宣传图因缺失「预购」字样被怀疑提前拿到游戏，双方均未回应。
summary.en: Outdoor ads landed at once on Hollywood Boulevard, in Brooklyn, across Chicago and in Times Square, including a hand-painted Colossal Media wall and Spotify billboards. An Xbox promo image missing the 'pre-order' label fuelled early-access talk; neither company has commented.
